First tagged release. Binaries for Linux, macOS and Windows, each with the app, `acid_render` and the CLAP plugin.

What's in it:

- New engine: a coupled diode-ladder filter run at 2x, stereo FX bus (drive, ping-pong tape delay, plate reverb, limiter), 16-voice drum machine.
- The 303 voice checked against published hardware measurements (Whittle, Stinchcombe, Open303): gate length, slides, accent sweep, filter feedback and an anti-aliased oscillator. `tests/voice_test.cpp` holds the numbers.
- acidflow as a CLAP instrument.
- Command palette, searchable help, right-click menus, session restore, MIDI learn, stem bounces.
- Themes come from maya now. Press `T` to pick any of its schemes with live preview.
- Ableton Link is gone, so everything is MIT.

Downloads:

- Linux x86_64 and arm64 (glibc 2.35+, needs ALSA; JACK used if running)
- macOS Apple Silicon (13+). Not notarized: run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine acidflow acidflow.clap` once.
- Windows x86_64 and arm64. Use Windows Terminal or another ANSI terminal.

`SHA256SUMS` has the checksums.
